content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

Crypto payment gateways are not just a workaround for Stripe or PayPal restrictions, but a fundamental shift in how we design and deploy digital commerce infrastructure. By using NOWPayments, a blockchain-based payment processing service, you can accept cryptocurrency payments directly on your website, without relying on centralized platforms. This not only saves you money on transaction fees but also gives you full control over your customer data and payment processing.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind a sovereign digital commerce stack is built on a combination of free and paid tools. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your online store, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver digital products. NOWPayments integrates with this infrastructure to provide automatic on-chain cryptocurrency payment verification, with a fee of just 0.5%.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. It's also ideal for those who want to save money on transaction fees and maintain full control over their customer data and payment processing. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can get everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including all 6 blueprints and 7 templates.
You can save up to 99% on transaction fees compared to Stripe or PayPal.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, follow these steps: sign up for a GitHub account and create a new repository for your online store. Choose a hosting option, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and set up your website. Next, integrate Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain cryptocurrency payment verification. You can get instant access to the Complete Builder Kit ($197) on the shop URL https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
